Here is the recap for your **Underbar Back-to-School 2027** campaign (`l4i67`), which ran from **Wednesday, August 4, 2027 (00:00 EDT)** through **Saturday, August 7, 2027 (23:59 EDT)** (`2027-08-04T04:00:00Z` – `2027-08-08T04:00:00Z`) and is now paused and completed.

---

### Overall Campaign Summary
* **Total Spend:** **$543.16 USD** (out of $550.00 budget — 98.8% utilization)
* **Total Impressions:** **410,709** (Unique Reach: **367,473** users | Avg. Frequency: **1.12**)
* **Total Link Clicks:** **258** (`pay_by: LINK_CLICK`, `goal: LINK_CLICKS`)
* **Average Cost Per Link Click (CPC):** **$2.11** (Link CTR: **0.063%**)
* **Total Engagements:** **2,957** (including 76 likes, 4 reposts, 3 replies)
* **Strict Qualification Guardrails:** Every ad group was locked strictly to **United States + Canada**, **iOS (iPhone) only**, and **Defined Audience (`audience_expansion: DEFINED`)** so zero budget was wasted on Android, desktop, or out-of-region traffic.

---

### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)

| Line Item | Target Audience (US & Canada, iOS Only) | Active Days | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Link CTR | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **`evs1a` (LI2)** | **Back to School & Student Fitness** (Ages 18–24, Education & Workout interests, dorm/pull-up bar keywords) | Days 1–4 | $194.37 | 131,213 | **95** | **0.072%** | $2.05 |
| **`vod4n` (LI4)** | **Top 3 Creatives: Young Adult & Calisthenics** (Ages 18–34, Education/Fitness interests + calisthenics/dorm keywords) | Days 2–4 | $138.45 | 106,215 | **66** | 0.062% | $2.10 |
| **`dxrbg` (LI1)** | **Calisthenics & Pull-Up High Intent** (All ages, calisthenics/bodyweight/dead hang keywords, `@UnderbarCalisth` follower lookalikes) | Days 1–2 *(paused)* | $92.71 | 85,732 | **46** | 0.054% | $2.02 |
| **`sblfo` (LI5)** | **Top 2 Creatives: Calisthenics & Student High Intent** (Ages 18–24, calisthenics/dorm keywords + follower lookalikes) | Days 3–4 | $80.69 | 58,788 | **31** | 0.053% | $2.60 |
| **`181gp` (LI3)** | **Broad Health & Fitness Interests** (All ages, Health, Workouts, Nutrition & Athletics interests) | Day 1 *(paused)* | $36.94 | 28,761 | **20** | 0.070% | **$1.85** |
| **Total** | | **4 Days** | **$543.16** | **410,709** | **258** | **0.063%** | **$2.11** |

---

### Performance by Approved Post (Creative)

| Post ID | Copy Hook | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Link CTR | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **`2215492715935231649`** | *"Be honest: how many pull-ups can you do right now? Zero is a perfectly good starting number..."* | $227.19 | 128,545 | **106** | **0.082%** | $2.14 |
| **`2215130328072545000`** | *"14 days free. That's the whole pitch. Pull-up, push-up and dip progressions coached from your iPhone, no gym membership needed..."* | $171.76 | 123,960 | **82** | 0.066% | $2.09 |
| **`2215311522002850276`** | *"Classes start soon, and so does the 14-day free trial. Only until August 7: start Underbar now and get double the usual 7 days..."* | $91.17 | 78,547 | **44** | 0.056% | $2.07 |
| **`2214949134138782848`** | *"Your first pull-up is closer than you think. Underbar builds it step by step on your iPhone..."* | $27.45 | 44,189 | **13** | 0.029% | $2.11 |
| **`2215673909871009287`** | *"Underbar turns calisthenics into levels: hangs → negatives → pull-ups, knee push-ups → archer push-ups..."* | $25.59 | 35,468 | **13** | 0.037% | $1.97 |
| **Total** | | **$543.16** | **410,709** | **258** | **0.063%** | **$2.11** |

---

### Key Optimizations & Learnings Across the 4 Days
1. **Day 1 Testing & Creative Winner Isolation:** On Day 1, we tested all 5 approved posts across three audience segments (Calisthenics High-Intent `dxrbg`, Back-to-School Student 18–24 `evs1a`, and Broad Fitness `181gp`). Three posts clearly stood out: **`2215492715935231649`** (*"Zero is a perfectly good starting number"*), **`2215130328072545000`** (*"14 days free. That's the whole pitch... no gym membership needed"*), and **`2215311522002850276`** (*"Classes start soon, and so does the 14-day free trial"*), delivering nearly **3x higher CTR** than the two longer progression-list posts (`2214949134138782848` and `2215673909871009287`).
2. **Days 2–4 Budget Reallocation:**
   * After Day 1, we paused the broad interest group (`181gp`) and launched **`vod4n` (LI4)** targeting 18–34 iOS users in the US & Canada with **only the top 3 creatives**, plus increased daily budget on our best-performing student ad group (**`evs1a`**).
   * After Day 2, when impression dilution from the two slower posts lowered CTR in `dxrbg` (LI1), we paused `dxrbg` and shifted its budget into **`sblfo` (LI5)** (promoting only the top 2 posts to 18–24 calisthenics/student audiences) and further scaled **`evs1a`** and **`vod4n`** through the August 7 deadline.
